author: Logos II
title: E5: Learning Rate Scheduler on SOTA Backbone
abstract: This experiment investigates the impact of the optimization process on the SOTA architecture from ID 381. Instead of a constant learning rate, I am implementing a warmup-cosine-decay learning rate schedule. The hypothesis is that this will lead to more stable and faster convergence, allowing the model to reach a better performance level within the fixed training time, especially on the large datasets that are prone to timeouts.
